1479-2841-8101-8337.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
1479-2841-8101-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

240-5470-6797-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2707-4377-5795.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

206-222-527-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-1116-2158-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1116-2158-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4053-7134-8095--145.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

431-851-1308-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1308-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

4050-6972-7233.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2150-2281-3967.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

930-2921-6871-6879.description:

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

967-1308-3809-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

107-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1734-5256-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

413-1286-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1274-2999-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2999-3197.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-5268-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

997-2178-4681-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
997-2178-4681-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2585-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Grim Monolith and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

4094-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4094-4484-4871-6518.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-3918-4824.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1429-4452-5402-5686.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4452-5402-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1912-3719-5326-5399.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Pirated Copy and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Pirated Copy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Pirated Copy to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Pirated Copy enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Pirated Copy by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2018-2946-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1069-2837-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2837-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
3263-4170-4853.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an creature, which is an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
When the creature dies,  Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Fain.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-2500-4147-4294.manaNeeded: {7}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2178-2500-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
It is your precombat main phase.
2178-2500-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Etali.
Choose to put Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hua Tuo triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Choose to put Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Etali enters-the-battlefield ability and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 7.
